metadata.question: Did northern Cambodia have more active fire detections than southern Cambodia between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did northern Cambodia have more active fire detections than southern Cambodia between August 2016 and February 2018?" We need to: 1. Define two regions: northern Cambodia and southern Cambodia 2. Use a fire detection dataset (like MODIS active fires: MODIS/006/MCD14ML) 3. Filter by date: August 2016 to February 2018 (2016-08-01 to 2018-02-28) 4. Count fire detections in each region 5. Compare counts Approach: - Use FAO GAUL or country boundaries to get Cambodia boundary - Split into northern and southern regions (maybe by latitude midpoint) - Use MODIS/006/MCD14ML (MODIS Active Fires) collection - Each feature in the collection is a fire detection event - Count features in each region Data quality checks: 1. Check if collection is empty (C1) 2. Check if counts are valid numbers (C3) 3. No pixel masking needed for fire detections We need to output: - Print counts for north and south - Final answer: A (Yes) if north > south, B (No) otherwise - Handle edge cases Implementation: - Use ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') for Cambodia boundary - Filter by ADM0_NAME = 'Cambodia' - Split using geometry bounds and midpoint latitude - Count using size() on filtered feature collections ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var startDate = '2016-08-01'; var endDate = '2018-02-28'; // Get Cambodia boundary var cambodia = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Cambodia')); // Get bounds and split into north/south var bounds = cambodia.geometry().bounds(); var coords = bounds.coordinates().get(0); var minLon = coords.get(0).get(0); var maxLon = coords.get(2).get(0); var minLat = coords.get(0).get(1); var maxLat = coords.get(1).get(1); var midLat = (minLat + maxLat) / 2; // Create north and south regions var northRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([minLon, midLat, maxLon, maxLat]); var southRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([minLon, minLat, maxLon, midLat]); // Clip to Cambodia northRegion = northRegion.intersection(cambodia.geometry()); southRegion = southRegion.intersection(cambodia.geometry()); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fires var fires = ee.FeatureCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML') .filter(ee.Filter.date(startDate, endDate)) .filter(ee.Filter.bounds(cambodia.geometry())); var fireCount = fires.size().getInfo(); console.log('Total fire detections in Cambodia:', fireCount); // Check if collection is empty if (fireCount === 0) { console.log('No fire detections found in date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Count fires in each region var northFires = fires.filterBounds(northRegion); var southFires = fires.filterBounds(southRegion); var northCount = northFires.size().getInfo(); var southCount = southFires.size().getInfo(); console.log('North Cambodia fires:', northCount); console.log('South Cambodia fires:', southCount); console.log('North area (approx):', northRegion.area().divide(1e6).getInfo().toFixed(1), 'km²'); console.log('South area (approx):', southRegion.area().divide(1e6).getInfo().toFixed(1), 'km²'); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (typeof northCount !== 'number' || typeof southCount !== 'number' || isNaN(northCount) || isNaN(southCount)) { console.log('Invalid count values.'); console.log('C3'); } else if (northCount > southCount) { console.log('North has more fire detections.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('South has equal or more fire detections.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
